articles.title: MDAF: A Multi-Dimensional Annotation Framework for Automated Foreign Policy Analysis
articles.summary: arXiv:2607.16219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Government websites contain a vast but underexploited body of textual evidence on foreign policy. This article develops a scalable approach for extracting structured information from policy texts and converting it into standardized event data, with policy event defined broadly as a statement or action. It proposes MDAF integrating an LLM workflow to automate foreign policy text identification, information extraction, and event classification. articles.title: Students' Perceptions of Peer Grading
articles.summary: arXiv:2607.16221v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Peer grading is widely used in education, yet it elicits mixed reactions from educators and students. Although many studies have examined students' views of peer grading, their findings are scattered, and no clear overall picture has emerged. To address this gap, we conducted a mixed-source thematic analysis of literature and student discussions on Reddit. articles.title: International Agreements to Limit Frontier AI: Objectives and Exit
articles.summary: arXiv:2607.16224v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An international agreement to limit AI development could be crucial to mitigate risks from AI. articles.summary: arXiv:2607.16780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in scientific research, but its scientific value is unlikely to be distributed evenly.
